snapshot.name: Recipe URL Ingestion and Processing
snapshot.description: Implement a system to ingest recipe URLs and process their content. This feature should handle URL input from users, fetch and parse recipe data from external URLs, and integrate the extracted recipe information into the application's data model. The system should support recipe discovery and data extraction from web sources, enabling users to add recipes to the application by providing URLs rather than manual entry.

stories.title: Implement Recipe URL Input and Validation
stories.description: Create a user interface component that accepts recipe URLs as input and validates them before processing. This includes a text input field, URL format validation, and error messaging for invalid URLs.
stories.objective: Build a URL input interface with validation that accepts recipe URLs and prepares them for content fetching.
acceptance_criteria: User can input a recipe URL in a dedicated text field
System validates URL format and displays error message for invalid URLs
Valid URLs are accepted and passed to the content fetching system
UI provides clear feedback on validation status (success/error states)
Input field includes placeholder text and helper text explaining supported sources
implementation_notes: Create a new view/component for URL input with text field and submit button
Implement URL validation using regex or native URL parsing (e.g., URLComponents in iOS, URL class in Swift, or equivalent)
Add error state UI that displays validation messages below the input field
Include a list of supported recipe sources (AllRecipes, Food Network, etc.) as helper text
Connect submit button to trigger recipe fetching workflow
Store validated URL in a temporary state variable for passing to next processing step

stories.title: Build Recipe Content Fetcher with Fallback
stories.description: Implement a network service that fetches recipe content from URLs and includes a fallback mechanism allowing users to manually paste recipe content if URL fetching fails. Handle network errors gracefully with user-friendly error messages.
stories.objective: Create a fetching service that retrieves recipe content from URLs with manual paste fallback for network failures.
acceptance_criteria: System successfully fetches HTML content from valid recipe URLs
Network errors are caught and display user-friendly error messages
User can manually paste recipe content when URL fetching fails
Fetched content is stored temporarily for parsing
System indicates loading state while fetching content
Timeout handling prevents indefinite waiting (max 10 seconds)
implementation_notes: Create a NetworkService class with a method to fetch URL content using URLSession (iOS) or equivalent HTTP client
Implement error handling for network failures, timeouts, and invalid responses
Add a timeout configuration (10 seconds) to prevent hanging requests
Create a fallback UI modal/sheet that appears on fetch failure with a text area for manual content paste
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures
Store raw HTML content in a temporary variable for the parsing step
Add loading indicator/spinner during fetch operation
